description:
Location: NYC (Hybrid – at least 4 days onsite/week, Monday - Thursday) 
 This is a 6 month consulting opportunity that can be extended up to 12 months 
 Visa Sponsorship: Talan does not sponsor U.S. work permits or employment visas. 
 We are looking for a strong C++ Developer to build a greenfield, low-latency market data application for a high-frequency trading firm. The ideal candidate will have strong OOP fundamentals, especially in C++, and will be passionate about developing new features on Trade and Market Access Platforms.
 Role and responsibilities 
 Design and develop high-performance C++ systems from the ground up for a global Market Data Feed Application
 Apply strong OOP, design patterns, data structures, and algorithms to build clean and maintainable systems

 Design scalable, low-latency components for real-time market data processing

 Develop network connectivity using UDP/TCP, including multicast

 Implement and integrate financial market data protocols including ITCH, PITCH, and OUCH

 Build market data processing and order book components

 Design concurrent, thread-safe systems with a focus on latency, throughput, and reliability

 Profile, benchmark, and optimize performance-critical code

 Optimizing this platform by using network and systems programming, as well as other advanced techniques to minimize latency
 
 Requirements
 3-5 years of C++ backend development
 Strong C++ programming and object-oriented design fundamentals (Must be familiar with C++ 23 features or latest C++ 17)

 
 Excellent knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and system design

 Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

 Experience building performance-sensitive or real-time systems is highly preferred.

 Company’s Benefits 
 At Talan, we invest in our employees' well-being and empower them with benefits, including:
 💵 Salary between USD $120,000 - 150,000
 💸401(k) retirement plan with company matching
 🌴15 days of paid vacation per year at hire and up to 27 according to seniority (annual untaken vacation days are cashed out)
 📴8 paid holidays + 5 sick days + 2 personal days per year
 ❤️‍🩹Company health, dental, and vision insurance plans + FSA
 🦺Voluntary STD and LTD
 🚍 Commuter/transit benefits
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
